evidence.title: CyrusOne Breaks Ground on First Data Center in Italy
evidence.excerpt: CyrusOne's March 2026 release reports that it officially broke ground on MIL1 in Segrate and that the facility will deliver 27 megawatts of IT capacity.

metadata.content_hash_scope: SHA-256 of 90919 content-decoded HTML response bytes retrieved after redirects
metadata.retrieval_method: Supplied content-decoded HTML capture with separate response headers and request-start timestamp; exact client flags were not recorded in the capture directory.
metadata.retrieved_at_semantics: Request-start UTC from the capture harness; the response HTTP Date is preserved separately and happened in the same second.
metadata.source_date_guardrail: The embedded publication timestamp and visible March 25, 2026 date anchor the lifecycle and capacity observations. The July 16 HTTP Last-Modified response header is transport provenance, not a new publication or onsite-observation date.
metadata.status_scope: The release reports an official groundbreaking, says the development is underway, and quotes the start of construction. It provides no reliable finer physical substage, so only generic under_construction is imported.
metadata.facility_scope: MIL1 is the first of two planned CyrusOne data centers in Milan. Only MIL1 is modeled; the source does not establish a current MIL2 construction project.
metadata.capacity_scope: The source explicitly assigns 27 megawatts of IT capacity to MIL1, comprising three planned 9-megawatt data halls. One planned 27MW project-level critical-IT row is imported; the three halls are not modeled or summed again.
metadata.renewable_guardrail: The statement that the new data center will run on 100% renewable energy is future design and operating intent. It is not current generation, grid draw, energy consumption, renewable matching, or operational evidence.
metadata.operation_guardrail: Peak construction employment, full-time employment when fully operational, waste-heat reuse, district-heating potential, landscaping, BREEAM targeting, roadworks, and other community commitments remain future or non-capacity metadata and do not establish completion or operation.
metadata.classification_guardrail: Customer capacity and connectivity wording does not identify a tenant, customer, user, workload, operating model, or entity role.
metadata.coordinate_guardrail: The authoritative Segrate and Milan locality is retained without geocoding. Coordinates and geometry remain null; road references, a parcel, footprint, or building centroid are not imported.
metadata.imagery_guardrail: Satellite imagery and computer vision play no role in identity or lifecycle status.

capacities.notes: Developer-reported future IT capacity for MIL1 as a whole. This planned 27MW critical-IT row is not current load, gross facility power, grid connection, generation, measured energy, renewable supply, or evidence of operation; the three 9MW data halls are components and are not added again.
